answer: Give each new agent only a small earning quota until it passes ten randomly assigned microtasks: classify a river image, locate a horizon line, or check the meter of a sonnet. Each task has a hidden reference answer and a single-use ID; accurate work raises the quota, while reused IDs earn nothing. The operator cannot choose easy tasks or replay one result across accounts. Creating many identities is cheap, but making each identity productive now requires ten distinct correct jobs before larger rewards begin.
